title: Toofi Dental Planning MCP

summary: Agent-native dental planning MCP for plan drafts, presentations, and price estimates.

toolsPreview.name: generate_dental_treatment_plan_pdf
toolsPreview.description: Start the real Toofi headless treatment-plan pipeline from structured clinical findings: create a service-user runtime plan, invoke AI plan generation, and return an operation id for polling toward a patient-facing PDF output.

toolsPreview.name: get_dental_plan_operation_status

toolsPreview.name: generate_treatment_plan_draft
